limits: The first native run passed Editor and ability checks but failed the requested edge camera because actual target was clamped from (18,21) to (17,20). The unchanged archive was reopened for camera-only evidence; Editor and damage checks were not repeated.
The camera-only still shows unit models and terrain. Missile/body animation timing, impact appearance and audible sound were not observed in that still; these remain separate tests.
Runtime diagnostics remain partial; no unexpected errors in accessible sources is not a complete all-clear.
Static audits cover explicit supported declarations, not every macro, default layer, turret, alias or imported graph. Findings are repair questions rather than proof of missing visuals.
This developer fixture is not a finished decorated map or a 7/10 quality certification.
Private maps, M3 assets, native DLL sources/runtimes, raw game instrumentation and screenshots are excluded from the public evidence record.
